description: The model's proposal. Not a :class:`Finding` until part 11 accepts it.

items.description:
"``caller`` calls ``callee``" — checked against the index's call graph.

Separate from :attr:`Adjudication.cited_evidence_ids` because an edge is
not a region: two functions can both be cited, both resolve, and have no
call between them. That is precisely the claim a reachability argument
rests on and the one a region citation cannot express.

confidence_self_report.description: From the spec's finding contract. ``review_required`` is not a score.

exploitability.description: Whether an attacker can drive it — never inferred from impact.

impact.description: What can happen — deliberately silent about whether it can be reached.

kind.description: What can happen if the defect is triggered.

severity.description: Weakness severity in isolation, before reachability is considered.

maintainability_impact.description: How the recommendation lands on the code that has to live with it.

effort.description: Weakness severity in isolation, before reachability is considered.

items.description:
Text the model says appears at a region it was issued.

The only claim *about source* that a machine can settle exactly: the bytes
either match or they do not. Prose describing code is not checkable and is
never treated as though it were, which is why quoting is a field rather
than something read back out of a rationale.

Part 11 compares this against the captured bytes with no normalisation at
all — not whitespace, not line endings. A quotation that has been tidied up
is a quotation of something the compiler never saw.

reachability.description: Whether the defect can be reached — argued separately from impact.

remediation.description: A fix strategy. The MVP recommends; it does not modify code.

verdict.description: The model's proposed disposition. Never the final state.

x-caudit-transforms: $ref/$defs are inlined at every use; a recursive definition is refused
'$defs' is removed: inlined at every reference, so no definition block survives
'$id' is removed: identifies this document; not part of the shape
'$schema' is removed: identifies the JSON Schema dialect; not part of the shape
'additionalProperties' is removed: rejected by structured output; unknown keys are refused by the pydantic model instead, which is the check that matters
'default' is removed: a response schema describes what must be returned, not what to assume when it is not
'discriminator' is removed: rejected by structured output; the union it tags is inlined
'title' is removed: pydantic derives it from the class name; it is noise in a prompt
'x-caudit-schema-version' is removed: our own annotation, carried in the cache key instead
anyOf with exactly one non-null branch becomes that branch plus nullable=true
properties are emitted in the order the model declares them
